name: fs.readFile
desc: Reads a whole file into memory. Without an encoding it returns a Buffer, which is the usual reason console.log prints numbers.

name: fs.writeFile
desc: Writes data and creates or replaces the file. Pass flag 'a' to append instead of truncating.

name: fs.readdir
desc: Lists directory entries. withFileTypes returns Dirent objects, so files and folders can be told apart without another stat call.

name: fs.mkdir
desc: Creates a directory. recursive creates missing parents and does not throw when the directory already exists.

name: fs.stat
desc: Returns metadata for a path: size in bytes, timestamps, and type checks. It follows symlinks, lstat does not.

name: fs.rm
syntax: await rm(path, { recursive: true, force: true })
desc: Deletes a file or directory. recursive removes a tree and force ignores a missing path, so the call is safe to repeat.

name: path.join
desc: Joins path segments with the platform separator and normalizes dots. It never produces a leading slash unless a part is absolute.

name: path.resolve
desc: Builds an absolute path from the current working directory. Later absolute parts replace everything before them.

name: path.basename, dirname, extname
desc: Splits a path into its pieces without touching the disk. basename takes an optional suffix to strip.

name: process.argv
desc: The command line arguments as an array. The first two entries are the Node binary and the script path, so slice them off.

name: process.env
desc: Reads environment variables as strings. A missing variable is undefined, so validate the ones the app cannot run without.

name: express.Router
desc: Groups routes for one resource in a separate file. Paths inside the router are relative to the mount point.

name: Custom middleware
desc: Runs before the route handlers. Call next to continue, send a response to stop, and never do both.

name: Express error handler
desc: The only middleware with four arguments, which is how Express recognises it. It must be registered after every route.

name: express.static
desc: Serves files from a folder without a route per file. The mount path is optional and defaults to the site root.

name: express.json
desc: Parses JSON request bodies into req.body. Without it req.body stays undefined and every POST handler breaks.

name: Route params and query
desc: Params come from the path pattern and query values come from the URL. Both arrive as strings.

name: Knex select and where
desc: Builds a SELECT query as a chain and returns a promise. Selecting columns by name keeps the payload small.

name: Knex insert
desc: Inserts one row or an array of rows. MySQL returns the new id as the first element of the result.

name: Knex update
desc: Updates matching rows and resolves with the affected row count. A missing where clause updates every row.

name: Knex delete
desc: Deletes matching rows and resolves with the count. del is the method name because delete is a reserved word.

name: Knex join
desc: Adds an inner join. Qualify column names once two tables share a name, and select explicitly to avoid collisions.

name: Knex transaction
desc: Runs several statements as one unit. A thrown error rolls everything back, so a half written booking cannot survive.

name: http.createServer
desc: The built in HTTP server behind Express. It handles every request with one callback and leaves routing to you.
